sections.admission_summary: Chief complaint: Chest pain, diaphoresis, dyspnea. Admitted for inpatient care.
sections.discharge_instructions: Drink plenty of fluids. Get adequate rest and avoid overexertion. Cardiology follow-up within 1-2 weeks. Cardiac rehabilitation enrollment recommended. Take ALL cardiac medications as prescribed: aspirin, statin, beta-blocker, ACE inhibitor/ARB. Do NOT stop without consulting cardiologist. Call 911 immediately for: chest pain, severe shortness of breath, palpitations, syncope. Resume a normal diet gradually as tolerated. Take dual antiplatelet therapy (DAPT) and statin daily. Cardiac rehab attendance strongly recommended. Restricted activity for 4-6 weeks. Avoid heavy lifting. Gradual return per cardiologist guidance. Call ambulance immediately for chest pain lasting >15 min, dyspnea, syncope, or cold sweats. Low-fat, low-sodium diet. Smoking cessation mandatory. Limit alcohol. Weight management.
sections.discharge_medications: Aspirin 81mg PO daily; Ticagrelor 90mg PO BID; Atorvastatin 80mg PO daily
sections.follow_up: Cardiology follow-up within 1-2 weeks. Cardiac rehabilitation enrollment recommended.
